description: This file is a code-behind for the LoginPage, handling user authentication for students, teachers, and admins in an online examination system. It manages login logic, session management, and page navigation based on user credentials.

classes.name: LoginPage
classes.description: Code-behind class for the LoginPage ASP.NET page, managing user login logic and navigation.

methods.description: Handles the page load event; currently does nothing.

methods.name: signupB
methods.description: Handles the sign-up button click, transferring users to the SignUpPage.

methods.description: Handles login button click; authenticates user as student, teacher, or admin, and redirects accordingly.
